ValidationRule.description: Blocks edits to the primary (synced) Quote of a Closed Won Opp once the Closed Won automation is complete (or at once for non-Subscription New Opps). Allowed with the Edit Closed Won Quotes custom permission. Honors On/Off Switch.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This is the primary Quote of a Closed Won Opportunity and can't be edited. Contact a Beacon Salesforce Admin if it needs to be changed.
